_comment: Local strangler routing table. 'target' is 'django' (port 8000) or 'mock' (port 8787). As port tickets land they flip entries from 'mock' to 'django'. Order matters: first match wins, so most-specific paths come FIRST. Wildcards use '*' (Caddy's path matcher).

routes.note: default: route everything not-yet-ported to mock-legacy
